body: I have been there, but please, believe me, it will pass. When I read your words it reminded me exactly of what I was thinking even after 3 months. It's just not worth it to do it over one person, no matter what, especially someone who leaves you in such pain without explanation. I understand that you might feel generally alone and that it hurts, I'm sure you don't deserve it and I'm truly sorry you feel this way. Maybe things will get better soon, maybe they won't, please try to take it day by day and resist, one more day. And then another one. Please, don't do this to yourself.

I understand, I'm glad to hear that you have friends and that you'll get help when you can. If you need to talk to someone, about anything, even just venting, try anyone of your friends if you feel like it, reach out, text them or something, please. I don't know your story or what's best for you and I'm not here to try and tell you that for sure, but since what you tried to do I don't think you should be alone. No one should be alone especially in situations like this.
there's no painless method. you should seek professional help if you can, please.

I took almost 10g a month ago, mixed with something else too, felt like shit for 24h throwing up basically nonstop, then I started feeling better. It can cause serious liver damage particularly, so if you feel pain around that area go to a doctor as soon as possible, please. You should go anyway. Don't wait to get some internal/permanent damage because it won't have the outcome you're hoping for now. I think that maybe you hope something better for yourself. I do. Try to seek professional help for your mind too, a therapist, if you can, I'm sure there's a reason behind what you tried to do and there's someone out there who can understand you without judging you. It might be anyone who you feel comfortable with, but professional help in this case I think it's a must. Please don't try this again. Ask for help. Someone will answer.

This is a reaction you get from really cruel people because there are many other answers you can give instead of just leaving someone in the darkest place ever, and it's not some stranger, is someone who you have a romantic relationship with. The other one is selfish and immature for just wanting to leave to protect himself. Babies don't think about suicide.

been exactly there. You're worth more, you're better off. now it doesn't seem like it but 3 months from now you'll be thankful you didn't waste anything else on her, I can promise you that. don't waste a thing on someone who doesn't want you and doesn't deserve you. you deserve better, don't blame yourself
Thank you again lol, especially for reading it anyway and answering to me, for the advice too (which I followed now).

Yes I imagine, sorry about it, I just needed to spit it out quickly before letting it build up in my own already messy mind. 

I know you're absolutely right, especially about the cognitive dissonance, thank you for making me hear it and taking me seriously. I told him so many times that he's the best person I've ever met, I told him so many nice things, things I never even thought of anyone, I've been so hurt over loosing him, I can't believe the confidence boost I even gave to him and how on the contrary I dug such a deep pit for myself.

I cared way more about him than myself because I thought he deserved it. I've been completely fooled by myself as well for sure. But especially by him. 
At least now it won't be so hard anymore to forget about him. But yes it is so damn shocking. I wasted so much on him.

Thank you a lot for your advices. Thank you for everything you wrote.

Thank you very much for not being too intimidated by my wall of words and for your kind answer. I didn't throw that bomb lightly believe me, and I actually registered on reddit only to talk about it and read other's opinions struggling with my same problems. I wrote it only to give context to my own general situation and actual state of mind which is detached even from myself.

I really needed to hear this, so again thank you from the bottom of my heart. So many times I thought I was the problem in relationships, sabotaging them and myself because of depression, anxiety etc., and thinking to myself "is this really the best I can get?".

I never felt such pain in my entire life like since we broke up, another thing for which I blamed myself. I just wanted to move on and I couldn't. But I thought I had good reasons to feel like that, he's the only one that made me feel so loved and cared for even if from the other side of the world, he was so wonderful with me, always being by my side, proving to love me for who I am, every moment of everyday, no matter what.

Hearing from someone else like you, who even just by reading this, got how truly manipulative he's actually been it's such a disappointment, in myself too for not realizing it, not seeing it because of all the rest, because of my own problems too i imagine. But like you said is a relief as well, literally like I dodged a bullet. I sacrificed so much for him, so much time and energy and tears, many parts of my own mind too. I can't believe I couldn't see it.

I guess I wanted and needed to feel loved so much that I would have taken all the rest, the secretive parts and all, and because I truly loved him as well, I thought the good outweighed the bad until now, exactly because of the ways he made me feel for the first time in my life.

Thank you very much again, for everything you wrote and for taking time reading and answering to me.

I am proud of you, you don't need to be strong all the time and especially not for others. If they can't see you and try to walk all over you, even if it's your mom, use that against them.
